answer: Every grade carries a posted stake, and a second panel re-checks a random slice of them. Payment sits in escrow until the submission reaches finality, two epochs here. Duplicates are caught by replaying the payload, so a copied answer fails even under a new name. The incentive is the whole story: a bought grade costs stake plus the risk of the sample, and the sample is random. A pigment of doubt on one reviewer spreads to the panel, a wharf of cloned payloads fails the replay check at dawn of settlement, and escrow refunds the other side.
